description: Asks to add a domain the person owns (such as www.acme.com) to a project, as the project's Domains settings do. Owners and admins of the project only. Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Once approved, the answer of get_approval lists the DNS record to add at the domain's provider; check_domain says who that provider is and shows when the record is seen. The address goes live by itself once the record is in.

component_id.description: Which part of the project, when it has more than one that can take an address.

hostname.description: The domain or subdomain, such as www.acme.com.

project_id.description: The project the domain points at (list_projects gives ids).

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: connect_domain
title: Connect a domain to a project
